messages:
maria: heads up — provisioning stuck in us-west-2, GPU nodepool not scaling. lots of Pending pods with failed binding.
kevin: seeing same, cluster-provisioner logs show repeated "acquire_lock timeout" on leader-election.
sre-anna: jumping in — attaching logs now. looks like lease wasn't renewed for the controller leader.
deploy-bot: Autoscaler: scaleUp 0->10 requested, provider API timed out (PUT /asg) — 504 Gateway Timeout.
infra-max: cloud provider API is flakey right now (spike of 429s for spot requests). fallback plan: create an on-demand gpufallback nodepool and move critical pods.
oncall-jay: approved — create on-demand pool and set taints to reserve for critical. cost ok for emergency.
maria: cmds below to evict noisy research job and drain backlog before new nodes join:
```bash
kubectl -n research delete pods -l job=param-sweep --grace-period=30
kubectl -n infra annotate node <node> emergency-evict=true
```
kevin: running delete now. also patching priorityclass on model-serving to ensure they schedule on new nodes first.
sre-anna: created gpufallback-usw2-ondemand via console (manual create was faster than terraform), added taint: gpu-rescue=true:NoSchedule.
infra-max: will add toleration to critical DaemonSet temporarily: pls update deployment config.
ops-liz: FYI I bumped provider quota for on-demand instances in us-west-2 (requested + approved in console).
deploy-bot: Node join events: 4/10 gpufallback-usw2-ondemand nodes Ready. autoscaler still retrying spot requests in parallel.
maria: routing policy: set smart-routing to prefer gpufallback pool for critical model-serving via tags — done.
kevin: pods beginning to bind -> several critical pods now running on on-demand pool. latency improving. :thumbsup:
sre-anna: root cause draft: leader-election lease writes were failing due to transient cloud provider API evictions for spot requests, which blocked the provisioning controller from reconciling. followups: leader-election backoff tweak, add metrics/alert for consecutive leaseRenewFailures, and a fast-path in controller to fallback to on-demand when X failures.
oncall-jay: created incident ticket INC-2494, assigned to eng-infra for tomorrow postmortem.
maria: summary for Slack — emergency mitigation: manually created on-demand gpufallback nodepool, tainted nodes, evicted runaway research pods, patched priorityclass for critical services, traffic failed over. cost impact minimal due to 2h window. next steps: postmortem, controller fallback, runbook update.
ops-liz: noted — I'll add cost delta snapshot and tag for chargeback.
sre-anna: i'll own the postmortem write-up. ping me if you have logs or kubectl history to attach.
maria: thanks all, closing channel for now — will reopen if nodes degrade. :heart:
